families.basis: TI SPRU172C SQUR, SQURA and SQURS instruction descriptions; explicit signed and fractional arithmetic results, destination selection and instruction costs.
obligations: opposite accumulator preservation where previously asserted
selected overflow and carry bits, without strengthening partial-mask expectations
two port writes separated by the original three or four instruction clocks
no illegal instruction and final idle state
limits: no pipeline or silicon phase claim
no save-state coverage in the original family
the default sequence retains its explicit continuation; standalone cases reset independently

families.basis: TI SPRU172C page 4-142: RND adds 2^15, with the documented OVM behavior. Literal raw/saturated results cover signed 32-bit boundaries and 40-bit wrap without using CPU helpers.
obligations: all four source/destination selections and opposite accumulator preservation
OVM clear/set and two preserved status patterns
final PC, idle and illegal-instruction state
limits: default-sequence coverage only; no claim of independently emitted case identities
no checkpoint/replay Cartesian product in this family
families.rationale: The 128-case matrix is already compact and protects distinct arithmetic and preservation boundaries. Keep it rather than force a rewrite for a small line-count gain; prioritize shared harness ownership and large replay matrices. CPU-only relocation remains separate from this retention decision.

families.basis: TI ADDM/ANDM/ORM operand and status semantics, plus explicitly model-owned staged retention/publication ordering. The old 153600 cases contain four identical copies of 38400 stimuli; only the checkpoint differs.
families.legacy_entry: default phase 252890; also the long-mvkd bundle

rmw-long.encoding: FNV-1a64 over little-endian uint32 keys in execution order

rmw-long-full.encoding: FNV-1a64 over little-endian uint32 keys in execution order

obligations: all four checkpoints for each of 4800 operation/address/compatibility/status groups, twice each across eight value pairs
retained offset, literal, pointer and sampled operand despite later mutation
one read, one write, two extension fetches and operation-owned flags across replay
independently checked ordered case/checkpoint digest and actual restore count
limits: balanced default does not claim the full value-by-checkpoint product; exhaustive profile retains it
exact staged cycle placement is a model contract, not measured silicon
peripheral RMW and absolute XORM are separate, unchanged families
still uses the sequenced bench; CPU-only relocation is not claimed
